text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
(The sweetness of the chocolate and the softness of the sponge 
look correct. I may have needed 9 minutes, but I think I've 
adapted well and regained my footing.)

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Sachertorte — finished. Adjustments complete. 
I should have no problem competing.
—a few hours ago.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We're looking for lots, lots, lots of contestants for the 
"Yuushun Chocolate Contest" again this year!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This is one of the events that will be held at the 
"Chocolate Festival" sponsored by Yuushun Confectionery, 
known for their slogan "The Apex of Sweets"!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A chocolate expo, a huge sweets buffet, and a sweets performance 
by pastry chefs from around the world await!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It's a confectionary contest that attracts students 
from schools all over Japan! First come, first served! As a 
representative of the academy, I hope you'll consider it!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, that takes care of your registration! 
The teams consist of pairs, so you'll have to wait until 
another person joins before you can actually enter.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
… By the way, Flash, I heard you're going to take 
over your parents' cake shop after graduating. 
Are you looking to test your skills?

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Uh, rather, I… decided to participate because Yuushun 
Confectionery is actually my family's business partner, and I 
was hoping to repay their kindness.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't participate half-heartedly. I'm determined to 
make the contest exciting and turn it into a bridge to the next…

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. Hehe, I love seeing your enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Now, if you could contact 
me when the other person joins…

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Is this where I can register 
for the Yuushun Chocolate Contest?

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the first Yuushun Chocolate Contest Strategy 
Meeting. Please refer to the documents for the agenda.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
—First, let's check the rules. For the Yuushun Chocolate Contest, 
each team will prepare a recipe based on the theme in advance.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Then, on the day of the event, the work will be done at the 
venue. The time limit is 5 hours. There will be 2 contestants. 
You can bring up to 3 people to help with preparations.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
Next, I will expand on the procedure for ordering the uniforms. 
Uniforms will be provided to the two contestants by the school.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
Each participant should select a base design from the catalog, 
fill in the size, and submit the form to Tazuna within 7 days.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I appreciate the provision of uniforms. I 
can move more efficiently when I'm wearing optimized clothing.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Next, I would like to reaffirm the theme and the future flow. 
This year's theme is "Schoolhouse-inspired Chocolate Sweets".

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
This is an abstract topic, and there are many ways to express it. 
In other words, the more ideas you have, the more options you 
have and the better off you are.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
We'll start by gathering helpers and drawing as many designs as 
possible. I think the most efficient method would be to pile up 
prototypes. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text: "Calculating" — Proposal judged most efficient. No objections.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Right then, after a 3-minute break, check your training schedule 
and calculate your free time. Let's create a concrete schedule.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
… Going off topic a bit, but Bourbon, 
are you interested in baking?

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text: It's a little different from "Interested".

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
Prototype 5, sponge elasticity is 13% below 
ideal. Status "Failure" confirmed. …Conclude that 
more advanced skills are needed.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
"Valentine only comes once a year, don't forget those 
friend-chocolates!" "Express the gratitude you can't normally 
with splendid chocolates!"

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Rice, Ms. Bakushin O, and Ms. Flower…… 
Many people I "wish" to hand a gift.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
…"Searching" for efficient training 
methods immediately— …"Yuushun Chocolate Contest".

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I joined because I "wanted to improve my skills". 
Target level is… enough to win the contest.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the target is the grand prize of 
the Yuushun Chocolate Contest.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text: I see… I'm relieved.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text: "Relieved"?

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
The reason for my participation is to repay Yuushun 
Confectionery. My goal is to win the Grand Prize, 
and nothing else is on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
…A shared goal is essential in team games. I'd like to 
thank you again. —Let's aim for "The Apex of Sweets" together.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text: Yes…!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
(Purple violas and pink pansies… I hope 
the older girls will be happy with these flowers.)

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: —Kyaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Flower!?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine! It's just that the planter was a little too big 
and I couldn't see my feet…

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate B
text_block_list.text: I see～. Then we'll take it! Can I carry it over there?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: What? Oh, but…!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, it's okay. I don't want you to get hurt again! You're 
still small and some things are just tougher, don't sweat it!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I'm sorry… —Haa…

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
(I'm trying to be reliable… but I've 
been taken care of again…)

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
Visual on Ms. Flower. Greetings. I know 
this is sudden, but I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text: Can you please help me with the "Yuushun Chocolate Contest"?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: A helper, huh? And, uhm… you want me?

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text: Of course. Please lend us your cooking skills.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: —So, I'm here to help! I'll do my best, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Same here, I'd love to help as much 
as I can! I'll take care of everything!

text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон
text_block_list.text:
Both of them agreed to do so, as they had 
plenty of free time on their hands.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
That's reassuring. I look forward to working with 
both of you… Actually, I have invited one more 
person who can bring ideas that I don't have.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Heya, I heard there's tons of free sweets if I help? Is that on?

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it won't be that long, but 
I look forward to working with you!
